#### Clase `BrokenResourceError` (Línea 12)
- **Docstring:** _Raised when trying to use a resource that has been rendered unusable due to external
causes (e.g. a send stream whose peer has disconnected)._

#### Clase `BrokenWorkerProcess` (Línea 19)

otherwise misbehaves._

#### Clase `NoEventLoopError` (Línea 137)
- **Docstring:** _Raised by several functions that require an event loop to be running in the current
thread when there is no running event loop.

This is also raised by :func:`.from_thread.run` and :func:`.from_thread.run_sync`
if not calling from an AnyIO worker thread, and no ``token`` was passed._
